title: 第3693章 我要是不退呢怎么和说的不一样第3692章 仇人见面分外眼红青之至尊苍鬼
slug: 开局废了我开启最强进化
content_zh:
苍鬼的等级为宇宙至尊一级，却在宇宙至尊沉淀千万年之久。
真正的实力可不是普通的宇宙至尊一级能够相媲美的。
即便等级上是宇宙至尊一级，恐怕苍鬼现在已经触摸到了至尊二级的门槛。
再给对方一些时间，或许就有机会能够突破宇宙至尊二级也说不定。
而苍鬼所掌握的法则，是叶凌从没听说过的青之法则。
宇宙何其之大，法则数量多不胜数。
叶凌没有见过的法则之力不知凡几，这所谓的青之法则，一定有其独到之处。
目光转移到叶凌身上，苍鬼仔细地打量了一番。
“小子，你就是那个人族天骄叶凌？
此事和你人族无关，带着你的人退去。
否则......别怪本尊不给人族情面。”
苍鬼对白虎令势在必得，但他也不想和人族完全撕破脸。
贸然打破白虎圣地的平衡，若在这个时候有外敌入侵，情况会很麻烦。
千万年前，光是覆灭白虎一族，鬼族和妖族都付出了不小的代价。
若没有至尊坐镇，两族的位置恐怕早就成易主了。
如今白虎圣地维持着一种平衡状态，突然之间打破这来之不易的平衡，不是什么好事。
能避免打破平衡，苍鬼也会尽可能地避免。
赤裸裸的威胁！
可惜，叶凌可不是个会受威胁的人。
“哦？那……我要是不退呢？”

神色依旧，叶凌脸上看不出半分紧张。
见叶凌这副胸有成竹的样子，苍鬼心中一时间也有些拿捏不准，这人族小子到底是怎么想的。
难不成真要为了白娅，和自己这个宇宙至尊作对？
微眯着赤红的双眼，苍鬼属实想不明白，眼前这个人族小子究竟是哪来的自信。
就算是人族的天骄，又有什么资格和自己这个宇宙至尊这般对话。
哪怕是人族至强存在的空，在面对自己这个宇宙至尊的时候，也必须要保持足够的敬意。
而叶凌似乎根本不知道他面对的究竟是谁，竟敢如此大放厥词。
嘴角咧开，苍鬼突然发出了肆意放荡的大笑。
“哈哈哈哈！！”
声音震天动地，仅仅是声波产生的气浪，都对周围造成了不小的冲击。
笑声渐止，苍鬼死死地盯着叶凌，声音逐渐冰冷。
“小子，你……胆子很大，已经有很多年没人敢这么和本尊说话了。
既然不想走，那就别走了。
人族若是想找本尊的麻烦，那本尊也不会客气。”
苍鬼不会因为叶凌，就放弃要夺取白虎令的想法。
没有白虎令，鬼族就无法成为白虎圣地真正的主宰，替代曾经的白虎族。
“希望你的实力和你的口气一样大，可别让本尊失望。”
在苍鬼声音落下的那一刻，他举起右臂重重落下。
随着他的手势，周围团团包围的鬼族主宰们不带半点犹豫，立刻冲向叶凌他们。
至尊的命令，他们这些做下属的自然要遵从。

五名巅峰主宰外加近二十名宇宙主宰，这份力量，几乎已经能够横扫万族战场了。
content_en:
Cang Gui's level is the first level of the Universe Supreme, but he has been settling in the Universe Supreme for tens of millions of years.
The real strength is not comparable to that of ordinary Universe Supreme Level 1.
Even if the level is the first level of the Universe Supreme, I am afraid that Cang Gui has now touched the threshold of the second level of the Supreme.
If you give the opponent some more time, you might have a chance to break through to the second level of the Universe Supreme.
The law that Cang Gui masters is the Law of Qing that Ye Ling has never heard of.
The universe is so big and the number of laws is countless.
There are countless laws of power that Ye Ling has never seen before. This so-called Law of Blue must have its own uniqueness.
Turning his attention to Ye Ling, Cang Gui looked at him carefully.
"Boy, are you Ye Ling, the genius of the human race?
This matter has nothing to do with your human race, take your people and retreat.
Otherwise...don't blame me for not showing mercy to human beings. "
Cang Gui is determined to win the White Tiger Order, but he doesn't want to completely break up with the human race.
If you rashly break the balance of the White Tiger Holy Land, if a foreign enemy invades at this time, the situation will be very troublesome.
Thousands of years ago, just to destroy the White Tiger clan, both the ghost clan and the demon clan paid a heavy price.
Without the Supreme Being in charge, the positions of the two clans would have changed hands long ago.
Nowadays, the White Tiger Holy Land maintains a state of balance. It would not be a good thing to suddenly break this hard-won balance.
If he can avoid breaking the balance, Cang Gui will try his best to avoid it.
A naked threat!
Unfortunately, Ye Ling is not a person who will be threatened.
"Oh? Then...what if I don't retreat?"
The look remained the same, and there was no trace of nervousness on Ye Ling's face.
Seeing Ye Ling's confident look, Cang Gui was a little unsure for a moment as to what this human boy was thinking.
Is it possible that he really wants to fight against himself, the supreme being of the universe, for Bai Ya?
Squinting his red eyes slightly, Cang Gui really couldn't figure out where the confidence of the human boy in front of him came from.
Even if he is the genius of the human race, what qualifications do he have to have such a conversation with himself, the supreme king of the universe.
Even Sora, the strongest being in the human race, must maintain enough respect when facing himself, the supreme being of the universe.
Ye Ling seemed to have no idea who he was facing, yet he dared to speak so wildly.
With his mouth wide open, Cang Gui suddenly let out a wanton and wanton laugh.
"Hahahaha!!"
The sound was earth-shattering, and just the air waves generated by the sound waves caused a considerable impact on the surroundings.
The laughter gradually stopped, and Cang Gui stared at Ye Ling, his voice gradually becoming colder.
"Boy, you... are very brave. It has been many years since anyone dared to talk to me like this.
If you don’t want to leave, then don’t leave.
If the human race wants to cause trouble for me, I won't be polite. "
Cang Gui will not give up the idea of seizing the White Tiger Order just because of Ye Ling.
Without the White Tiger Order, the ghost clan would not be able to become the true masters of the White Tiger Holy Land and replace the former White Tiger clan.
"I hope your strength is as strong as your tone, but don't let me down."
The moment Cang Gui's voice fell, he raised his right arm and dropped it heavily.
Following his gesture, the surrounding ghost masters rushed towards Ye Ling and the others without any hesitation.
Those of them who are subordinates must obey the orders of the Supreme Being.
Five peak masters plus nearly twenty universe masters, this power can almost sweep across the battlefield of all races.
